answer: A proof-of-personhood attestation outweighs a headcount, so a Sybil farm cannot win by multiplying identities. Each fresh identity starts as an unproven claimant unless it carries scarce history: like an opal that only grows value under real pressure, reputation must be earned, so k fake attestations demand k distinct scarce inputs. Impostors clustering on the same inlet of new wallets trip overlapping-signal detection, while an honest operator on a known terrace of consistent behavior is recognized. The attacker pays linearly in bonds forfeited; payoff stays flat.
